comparison.objective: Replace a worn electric-toothbrush head with a new packaged head.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize the handle, overcome axial press fits, open packaging, and align a replacement on a narrow shaft.
comparison.success_condition: New head is fully seated, worn head discarded, and arms returned; partial credit covers opening and removal.
comparison.reason: This tests axial press-fit removal and insertion, not preserving a rotary stop setting while locking a coupled screw and nut.
